title: Coverage matrix: taxpayer type x registration or election x form x source x readiness (v1)
status: PROPOSAL for readiness. Facts are cited in the status column. No live BIR, Rox or cloud calls were made.

readiness_values.supported: Books and the pinned forms cover it end to end, with tests

readiness_values.unsupported: No mapping, or out of phase; do not offer it
readiness_values.needs-review: Covered only after an owner or tax-adviser decision or a cited rule is confirmed
